# Appropriation Ordinance No. 01, Series of 2018 — Supplemental Budget #01

## Summary

This appropriation ordinance enacts Supplemental Budget No. 01 for the [[Municipality of Pitogo]], [[Quezon Province]], approved via Resolution No. 122. The supplemental budget involves funds sourced from surplus as of December 31, 2017 amounting to P9,871,041.34 and savings from Personal Services, 20% Development Fund, and Kalahi CIDSS-MOOE amounting to P12,814,899.53, for a total supplemental appropriation of P22,685,940.87. The ordinance was introduced by [[Coun. Esperanza A. Tan]] and draws authority from several provisions of the [[Local Government Code of 1991]].

## Key Provisions

- Appropriates a total of P22,685,940.87 as supplemental budget for the municipality.
- Sources of funds: surplus (as of December 31, 2017) of P9,871,041.34 and savings of P12,814,899.53.
- Savings drawn from Personal Services, 20% Development Fund, and Kalahi CIDSS-MOOE.
- Approved as Resolution No. 122 of the Sangguniang Bayan.
- [[Fidel M. Malapit]] (PPLB) absent during session.
